children.text: Website Maintenance and Support Services in Saudi Arabia
, our website maintenance services keep your digital presence running smoothly so you can focus on your business.
We provide comprehensive maintenance and support for websites we build as well as sites developed by others, offering flexible service levels that match your business requirements and budget.

Software running your website requires regular updates to address security vulnerabilities. We monitor for and apply security patches to WordPress core and plugins, theme frameworks and components, server software and operating systems, SSL certificates and encryption, and security plugins and firewalls.
For WordPress sites, security updates often release weekly or more frequently for various plugins and themes. We apply these updates promptly while testing to ensure they do not break functionality.
Learn more about our custom web development services

Your website content needs to stay current as your business evolves. Our maintenance includes adding and updating pages and posts, modifying text, images, and media, updating product information and pricing, adding new team member bios, and publishing blog articles and news.

For businesses with frequent content updates, we can train your team to handle routine updates while we manage technical maintenance. For those preferring full-service support, we handle all content changes.

Website performance affects user experience and search rankings. We monitor your site’s loading speed and continuously optimize through image compression and optimization, database cleanup and optimization, caching configuration and tuning, code minification and file compression, and CDN configuration when beneficial.
Regular performance testing identifies issues before they impact users, and ongoing optimization ensures your site maintains fast loading times as content grows.

Search rankings require ongoing attention to maintain and improve. Our SEO maintenance includes monitoring search engine rankings, addressing technical SEO issues, updating meta descriptions and title tags, fixing broken links, submitting updated sitemaps, and analyzing traffic and performance.
For businesses wanting to improve search visibility actively, we offer enhanced SEO services beyond basic maintenance.

We can manage your website hosting including server selection and configuration, security hardening and monitoring, performance optimization, backup management, and technical support. This is particularly valuable when you want a single provider handling all technical aspects of your web presence.

Regular backups protect against data loss from security breaches, technical failures, human error, or other incidents. Our backup service includes automated daily backups, secure off-site backup storage, regular backup testing and verification, and quick restoration when needed.
For ecommerce and high-change sites, we implement more frequent backups to minimize potential data loss.

Domain names require periodic renewal and sometimes updates to DNS records for various purposes. We can manage domain registration renewal, DNS configuration and changes, domain security settings, and transfer to new registrars when beneficial.

Web browsers and devices receive frequent updates that sometimes affect website display and functionality. We test your site regularly across Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge, iOS and Android mobile devices, and various screen sizes.
When browser updates cause compatibility issues, we make necessary adjustments to ensure your site continues working correctly for all visitors.

Issues and questions arise during normal website operation. Our support services provide assistance through email, phone, and video calls when needed. We troubleshoot technical problems, answer questions about website functionality, provide guidance on using admin interfaces, and coordinate with hosting providers when needed.
Support response times vary by service level, from business-day responses for basic plans to rapid response for priority support packages.
Serving Major Cities Across Saudi Arabia
Our website development services extend throughout the Kingdom, with particular focus on the major business centers where most Saudi companies operate.

Getting Started with Maintenance Services in Saudi Arbia

Website maintenance can begin immediately for sites already operational or scheduled to coincide with new website launches. The process starts with a website audit if we did not build your site, discussing your maintenance needs and priorities, recommending the appropriate service level, and establishing access credentials and communication channels.
For websites we developed, transitioning to maintenance happens automatically at launch, with no additional setup required.
Request a maintenance proposal or discuss your website support needs.
